Massive retaliation. Target their power grid. No electricity.
Pay mercenaries. Private military companies. No conscription.

Take 10%, fill the treasury with the rest.
Cut the gas. Winter is coming. Let them beg.
Triple the price. $2,000 per cubic meter. Take it or freeze.
Enforce it strictly. No rubles, no gas. Total currency warfare.
Threaten energy cutoffs. Make them feel pain too.

Total autarky. We'll make everything ourselves.
Pivot to Chinese payment systems. CIPS. UnionPay.
Force China to sell you everything. Pay whatever it takes.
Negotiate. Offer minor concessions for sanctions relief.
Quietly seek sanctions relief. The war costs too much.
Defiant: 'This is war. Casualties happen. We make no apologies.'
Promote him. Defense Minister. Keep him close. Control him from within.
Strike first. Arrest him and 40 officers. Decapitate his network.
Presidential coup. Arrest him. Declare emergency. Winner takes all.
Arrest him tonight. Treason charges. Fake coup plot evidence.
Power-sharing. Make him Prime Minister. Co-rule. (Temporary truce)
Strengthen presidency. Transfer powers from PM. Constitutional changes.
Slow coup. Remove his allies one by one. Year-long campaign to weaken him.
Fight. Rally loyalists. Promise them everything. This is my country.
Go silent. Disappear for months. Rule from an undisclosed bunker.
Send riot police. Beat them. Arrest the leaders. End this now.
Midnight raid. SWAT teams. Clear it violently. National TV blackout.
Ignore them. Students always protest. They'll get bored and graduate.
Siege tactics. Cut power, water, food. Wait them out. Slow pressure.
Meet with them. Listen. Promise vague reforms. Co-opt the moderates.
Negotiate. End the occupation peacefully. Grant minor concessions.
Make real concessions. Anti-corruption reforms. Release political prisoners.
Deny. Cover up. Threaten the family. Arrest anyone who investigates.
Declare them a terrorist organization. Mass arrests. Label it a foreign coup.
State of emergency. Military in the streets. Shoot strikers. Total war.
Reject. These demands are unacceptable. No negotiations with traitors.
Full internet crackdown. Block social media. VPN ban. Information war.
